How GoShopMe Works

1

Turn Inspiration into Buyable Options

See something you love? Upload a photo or video from social media or your camera. ShAI finds the closest matches — personalised to your size, preferences, and the best price.

2

The Same Look. The Best Price.

Send ShAI a screenshot and she finds it across every store — then shows you who has it cheapest. Luxury out of budget? She finds the same vibe for less, without the compromise.

ShAI guides you through checkout and manages the purchase. From order confirmation to returns — all decisions happen in one chat.

Questions

Frequently Asked

What is GoShopMe? +
GoShopMe is an AI-first personal shopping platform powered by ShAI — an autonomous AI agent that searches, recommends, and completes fashion purchases on your behalf.
What is ShAI? +
ShAI is your AI personal shopper inside GoShopMe. Chat by text or voice, share inspiration photos, and ShAI finds the best matches across online stores — personalised to your size, style, and budget.
How does ShAI find products for me? +
ShAI searches across multiple online retailers in real time. Share a photo or describe what you want, and ShAI returns personalised options — including the original, budget alternatives, and luxury picks.
Can ShAI complete my purchase? +
Yes. ShAI handles the full checkout process — from order confirmation to returns — entirely inside the chat. No juggling multiple websites.
What about returns? +
Just ask ShAI. Describe the issue and ShAI handles the return — no forms, no phone calls, no hassle.
When is GoShopMe launching? +
GoShopMe is in pre-launch. Over 15,000 shoppers are already on the waitlist. Join to get early access when we go live.
Is GoShopMe free? +
GoShopMe will offer both free and premium plans at launch. Early waitlist members receive exclusive launch offers.
